title: The Sky Is Still Open
summary: Final editorial splash leaves the series in motion: ordinary network traffic, new maintenance work and continued Tethergrid presence mean the argument and the engineering are not finished.
panelPlan: Full-page season-closing splash in bright late-day Mojave light. Launch-Shop is visibly packing to move while ordinary Public Sky activity continues in the background without spectacle.

Put a battered replacement engine component or ordinary maintenance part in the foreground, a modest relay indicator or message cue in the midground, and a distant Tethergrid aircraft changing course beneath an enormous open sky.
Do not invent a new enemy, crisis, destination or mission. The hook is recurrence: things break, requests arrive, institutions adapt, and the crew keeps moving.
Let the final typography open progressively into sky. BUILD ANOTHER WAY should read as the series credo; BACKYARD ROCKETS WILL RETURN is the final clean publication line.

dialogueInline.speaker: CAPTION
dialogueInline.text: Public Sky is carrying ordinary traffic.

dialogueInline.speaker: CAPTION
dialogueInline.text: Somewhere, a relay is failing intermittently.

dialogueInline.speaker: CAPTION
dialogueInline.text: Somewhere else, another community is waiting for a launch window.

dialogueInline.speaker: CAPTION
dialogueInline.text: There is a battered engine part on the deck.

dialogueInline.speaker: CAPTION
dialogueInline.text: Tethergrid is still in the sky.

dialogueInline.speaker: CAPTION
dialogueInline.text: Move before somebody closes the route.

dialogueInline.speaker: CAPTION
dialogueInline.text: That does not mean nobody will try.

directionInline.text: This is the non-diegetic final editorial page for the current eight-issue arc. Preserve exact caption text. It should feel complete but not terminal: no recap montage, no new plot event and no promise of a specific next mission. Echo the Issue 1 sky motif and the established series tagline while leaving the world visibly active.
